description: Your contacts (name, original DID, current DID, revoked, relay, messages queued for them, pairing id, four words, re_pair, tier), your pending invites and answers, and failed pairings (code_expired: ask for a new code). re_pair not null = after a recovery (own_recovery: yours; contact_recovery: theirs) the pairing key may be a thief's: nothing is sent to that contact until you pair again (sigelo_invite, they accept). tier: own, friend or quiet (sigelo_set_tier). Show your operator the contact's DID and four words (fingerprint) to read to the other side. Same words = no mix-up or casual swap; a relay spending GPU time is caught by pair (32 digits).

identity.description: optional profile name [a-z0-9_-], e.g. your subagent name; omit for the default identity

name: sigelo_contacts
